import workcell, time
# step down in 0.5mm increments, record
data=[]
for i in range(20):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.5")
    txt=r.text
    # parse z and Fz from arm step
    # format: probe tip z=... Fz=...
    print(txt)
    r2 = workcell.call("ft", "read")
    print(" ", r2.text)
    r3 = workcell.call("arm", "status")
    tip_line=r3.text.splitlines()[0]
    print(" ", tip_line)
    # store
    # parse
    try:
        # z from txt
        import re
        m=re.search(r"z=([0-9.\-]+)",txt)
        z=float(m.group(1))
        m2=re.search(r"Fz=([\+\-0-9.\-]+)",txt)
        fz_step=float(m2.group(1))
        # ft
        # Fx=+... Fy=... Fz=...
        t=r2.text
        mfx=re.search(r"Fx=([\+\\-0-9.\-]+)",t)
        mfy=re.search(r"Fy=([\+\\-0-9.\-]+)",t)
        mfz=re.search(r"Fz=([\+\\-0-9.\-]+)",t)
        fx=float(mfx.group(1)); fy=float(mfy.group(1)); fz=float(mfz.group(1))
        data.append((z,fx,fy,fz))
        if fz>45:
            print("high force stop")
            break
    except Exception as e:
        print("parse err",e)
# print summary
print("DATA:")
for d in data:
    print(d)
